purpose: Freeze the only permitted assembly semantics for the whole-building M0-G geometry before 3D analytical nodalization and global member connectivity.

coordinate_frame.xy: PT_MASTER_CURRENT common frame propagated through STOREY_SUPPORT_XY_REGISTRATION_v1.csv

roof_special_linked_confirmed_member_fea.counting_rule: Already counted once inside the 36 G5 ordinary beams; never create a second member.

analytical_node_semantics.extended_support_rule: Distinct documented beam incidences on the same physical support remain distinct analytical nodes.

member_assembly_rules.pt_beams: Use 51 effective PT beams; B-053 18-19 and B-054 23-22-prime are formal local-reopen additions from TAV-02S with TAV-02A crosscheck; prior revocations and duplicate suppression remain in force.
member_assembly_rules.upper_beams: Use STOREY_BEAM_TOPOLOGY_CURRENT_v1.csv as an index only; field authority remains in the G2/G3/G4/G5 source ledgers.
member_assembly_rules.columns: Use VERTICAL_COLUMN_SEGMENTS_CURRENT_v1.csv exactly; keep endpoint sections independently and do not interpolate section changes through a segment boundary.
member_assembly_rules.roof_ridges_and_eaves: Keep the three ridge axes and three eaves edge sets outside ordinary member connectivity until explicit structural-member evidence is established.
member_assembly_rules.roof_oblique_19_26: Use only G5-B036; G5-OBL-19-26 is a linked special-feature record, not a duplicate member.

provenance_and_watch_rules.upper_sheet_xy_registration: MIS-supported common-frame registration with DOC support identities

anti_inference_rules: Do not create a beam because two supports are aligned.
Do not extrude a support above its documented termination.
Do not copy a section from an adjacent storey to fill ND.
Do not normalize G5 roof geometry to a rectangular substitute.
Do not convert ridge/eaves geometry into structural members without explicit evidence.
Do not collapse beam-face nodes to support centroids.
Do not invent absolute/geodetic Z from the relative storey datum.
completion_definition: M0-G may be handed off only after a non-blocking global topology gate. WATCH/ND values remain explicit constraints for downstream M0-S/model construction and are never silently repaired.
